item.title: Israel reopening Gaza’s border crossing with Egypt on Sunday after long closure
item.description: JERUSALEM (AP) — COGAT, the Israeli military body in charge of coordinating aid to Gaza, said in a statement that starting on Sunday a “limited movement of people only” would be allowed through the Rafah crossing, Gaza’s main gateway to the outside world. item.title: Iraqi calligrapher’s handwritten Quran ends 6 years of artistry and craft
item.description: ISTANBUL (AP) — The finished work consists of 302 double sided scrolls, each measuring 4 meters (13 feet) in length and 1.5 meters in width. The sheets, resembling heavy parchment, were custom made for Zaman with a blend of traditional materials including eggs, corn starch and alum.
